column1: # proofs/ledger.tsv -- claims only the real services can show (Packit, Copr,
# GitHub), each with a fingerprint of the files it rests on. Checked by
# scripts/test-proofs.py (lint.sh runs it); its header has the rules.
# Everything that can be measured offline is not here but in a test suite,
# and selftest.py sees each of those checks red on every CI run.
# To close an open entry: observe it, write proofs/<claim>.md (OBSERVED and
# VERDICT lines; RED and GREEN for proven), set state, date and evidence,
# mech_hash=AUTO, then scripts/test-proofs.py --refresh.
# packit-routing        one push of build-<tool> builds exactly that package,
#                       a push to main builds nothing. Observed 2026-10-07
#                       and, with the actionlint job, again 2026-11-18
#                       (proofs/packit-routing.md)
# copr-runs-check       Copr runs the %check of syft, grype, grant and
#                       actionlint and the builds pass (CI's rpmbuild-check.sh
#                       does; that it is the same on Copr is what each
#                       package's first watcher bump since %check showed).
#                       Observed 2026-11-18 for the first three
#                       (proofs/copr-runs-check.md); open again since the
#                       actionlint job: closes once each of the four has built
#                       on Copr with the new jobs (actionlint's first build,
# copr-runs-check-tea   the same for tea. Open until tea's first Copr build
#                       since %check came in (456ed51): its last one,
# reconcile-heals-live  copr-reconcile re-pushes a lost trigger on GitHub and
#                       Copr builds it. Not provoked on purpose: losing a
#                       trigger for real would leave a release unbuilt.
